disposition: hour-scale variability alias; trial period rejected as evidence for a temperate planet
evidence: The broad phase diagnostic shows repeating peaks and troughs every few hours throughout the purported out-of-transit interval. Lomb-Scargle finds a short period close to an integer subdivision of the trial period. Both SAP and PDC show this behavior.
limits: Origin of the variable flux is not localized. This does not establish intrinsic pulsation of the target star and does not rule out additional planets.

additional_trial_reviews.disposition: Not promoted: approximately 58-fold alias of a remaining 2.7286-hour oscillation. Both SAP and PDC folds show repeated waves throughout the out-of-event interval.
additional_trial_reviews.limitations: The short-variation subtraction is diagnostic and fitted in already-inspected data. Source of the rapid variability remains unlocalized.
additional_trial_reviews.further_check: A separate targeted experiment removed up to two more sector-local periodic components and repeated the unchanged combined-season search. Neither retained trial passed the existing gates; see combined_residual/targeted_multimode.json. This is a post-review sensitivity diagnostic, not independent validation.
